import trimesh, numpy as np
# check band_points self-intersection / ordering and duplicates for t=1.2 (ch=0.7)
def saddle_top(x): return 54-14*(x/55)**2
def band(t):
    ch=min(2.5,max(t-0.5,0))
    pts=[]
    for x in range(-52,53,4): pts.append((x, saddle_top(x)-6+t))
    pts.append((55, saddle_top(55)-6+t-ch)); pts.append((55, saddle_top(55)-6-t+ch))
    for x in range(52,-53,-4): pts.append((x, saddle_top(x)-6-t))
    pts.append((-55, saddle_top(-55)-6-t+ch)); pts.append((-55, saddle_top(-55)-6+t-ch))
    return pts
for t in [6,5.6,4.6,1.2]:
    p=band(t)
    print(t, 'n',len(p), 'min y', min(y for _,y in p), 'max y', max(y for _,y in p))
    # check consecutive duplicates / direction: signed area
    area=sum(p[i][0]*p[(i+1)%len(p)][1]-p[(i+1)%len(p)][0]*p[i][1] for i in range(len(p)))/2
    print(' signed area', round(area,1))
